title: FLA import: morph (shape tween) style decoding is unverified — CMorphSegment styleFlags used as fill1, fill0Style/fill1Style captured but ignored, morph fill/stroke tables skipped, end shape reuses start styles
description:
DONE (task 1415): Rewrote CPicMorphShape read decode in packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts (decodeMorphData).

Verified against fixtures/morph-shape-tween-mx.fla (a color-changing tween: white->black gradient + green 10px stroke morphing to red->blue gradient + yellow 2px stroke; ground truth = the two keyframes' own CPicShapes).

Findings / fixes:
- CMorphSegment/CMorphCurve fields follow the class tag DIRECTLY (no CPicObjBase schema/flags/children prefix) — the old code's framing assumption was wrong (misparsed: bad-tag bailout, absurd curve coords).
- Coords are plain s32 SWF twips, NOT Point8_24.
- The 4 segment index s32s are [strokeStartIdx, strokeEndIdx, fillStartIdx, fillEndIdx], 0-based into the morph tables, -1=none. Old code used styleFlags as a fill1 index — wrong. New code uses the END indices for the reconstructed end shape (fill1=fillEndIdx+1, line=strokeEndIdx+1). VERIFIED: seg [0,1,0,1] -> start green+white/black, end yellow+red/blue, matching both keyframes exactly.
- CMorphCurve carries controlA/anchorA (start) + controlB/anchorB (end) + isLine + 3 pad. Decoded B geometry matches the real end keyframe's edges exactly (the two 'unknown s32' from the old code were the end control/anchor, not unknowns).
- Morph fill/stroke tables (previously length-consumed and DISCARDED) are now decoded into Fla8Fill[]/Fla8Stroke[] and stored as the end shape's styles (falls back to start styles on parse error). readMorphFillStyle/readMorphStrokeStyle added. fill[0] decodes to the exact start gradient (a=0.0244,tx=40, white->black); fill[1] the end red->blue.

Tests (packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/flash8-import.test.ts):
- 'start and end keyframes carry DISTINCT fill and stroke styles' (fixture).
- new describe 'decodeMorphData' with synthetic multi-fill/stroke morph bytes asserting the end-index mapping + table decode + shapeTweenBlend; -1 none case; plus a skip-with-reason for the end-frame-without-own-shape consumption path (no fixture available: this fixture's end frame always has its own CPicShape, so pendingMorphEndShape is decoded but not consumed into the timeline).
- Exposed __decodeMorphDataForTest.

docs/21 sec 13 / 13.1 rewritten to the verified layout.

Verify: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build exit 0. pnpm --filter @flash/core test = 5751 passed, only the 2 PRE-EXISTING empty-bytematch WRITER failures (task 1423; confirmed identical on clean origin/main via git stash), no new failures.
